title: No keywords, and make me laugh: why I built Quilon
description: Why I built Quilon: a statically typed language with no keywords, one number type, and a design rule that was mostly whether it made me laugh.

title: Trying the Arch Linux aarch64 effort on a Raspberry Pi 5
description: Comparing Arch Linux ARM with the unofficial aarch64 port at ports.archlinux.page — package versions, RPi 5 support gaps, and a step-by-step guide to building a bootable VM image for UTM.
